items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Gerald brought in a tune, that's right.

ctx.x: Wasn't that the session where Gerald Wilson brought in a number and Duke stole it from him?
Yeah, Gerald brought in a tune, that's right.

And Duke put his name on it? Changed one note in the melody and put his name on it as the composer and I think Gerald got co-composer or arranger credit. I think Gerald just got arranger credit. It was Gerald's tune.
